strongest_reason: Low willingness to pay (1/5) and low pain intensity (2/5) indicate insufficient market demand to sustain a SaaS business, despite the technical gap in group management APIs.
strongest_risk: Platform risk: Meta deliberately excludes group management from the official API due to spam/abuse concerns; any solution using unofficial methods faces constant ban risk and could be rendered obsolete if Meta adds group management or enforces stricter ToS.
unresolved_assumption: That developers are willing to pay for a reliable group management API when free open-source alternatives (Baileys, WhatsApp-web.js) exist and the customer perspective explicitly states low willingness to pay.
recommended_next_step: Discard this opportunity unless new evidence emerges that significantly changes the pain/frequency/WTP scores (e.g., primary research with 50+ WhatsApp automation developers showing higher pain and willingness to pay).
